text:
Haiti just ran the cleanest A/B test of the century.

Option A: the international system. Thirteen years of UN peacekeeping, billions in aid, an army of NGOs. Result: a president assassinated in his own bedroom, a capital run by gangs, more than a million people displaced. The peacekeepers themselves brought cholera to the island and killed nearly 10,000 Haitians. After the 2010 earthquake, the Red Cross raised half a billion dollars and built six permanent homes. Six. Oxfam staff were caught paying for sex workers in the ruins.

Option B: Bukele. A few weeks, 2,000 soldiers, armored vehicles, one clear objective. Result: the gangs are now writing letters to the UN asking for "mediation."
